title: Enakkoru Magan Pirappan
desc: Balu's mother desperately wants a grandson, but his wife gives birth to a baby girl. As Balu's mother suffers a heart attack, he ends up showing his friend's newborn son as his own to make her happy.

title: Soorakkottai Singakkuutti
desc: A happily married man meets a dancer and welcomes her into his family. However, things take a turn when she reveals her true intentions.

title: Thaaimaman
desc: Meena refuses to marry Rasappan as he is uneducated and rustic. In order to win her heart, he decides to become a minister and achieve success.

title: Dost
desc: A forest ranger joins hands with locals to prevent large-scale poaching that is prevalent in the nearby forests. However, his efforts infuriate a poaching baron who vows to exact revenge.

title: Winner
desc: Fed up with Sakthi's hooliganism, his parents send him to stay with his grandparents in their village. However, he gets into more trouble when the family of the girl he loves does not accept him.
